description: This file defines the Perl module Mail::Address, which provides parsing and formatting functionalities for email addresses, including extracting names, hosts, and users from email address strings.

classes.name: Mail::Address
classes.description: A Perl class representing an email address, with methods for parsing, formatting, and extracting components such as name, host, and user.

methods.name: _extract_name
methods.description: Extracts a person's name from a comment or phrase in an email address.

methods.name: _tokenise
methods.description: Tokenizes an email address string into components for parsing.

methods.name: _find_next
methods.description: Finds the next token in the tokenized email address components.

methods.name: _complete
methods.description: Completes the creation of a Mail::Address object from parsed components.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Mail::Address object.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an email address string into its components.

methods.name: phrase
methods.description: Getter/setter for the phrase component of the address.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Getter/setter for the comment associated with the address.

methods.name: set_or_get
methods.description: Internal method to set or get component values.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats address components into a properly formatted email address string.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Extracts the display name from the address components.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host part of the email address.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Returns the user part of the email address.
